version.changelog:
- Improved documentation clarity with English descriptions for broader accessibility.
- Expanded explanation of testing strategies, including functional, non-functional, and regression testing.
- Added detailed sample templates for unit, UI, and integration test cases.
- Introduced example sections (e.g., todo app) demonstrating generated test coverage.
- Outlined auto-trigger actions and integration points within the auto-dev-pipeline.
- Specified quality metrics, code coverage targets, and accessibility compliance standards.

llm.summary: This skill is a straightforward QA helper that generates SwiftUI test plans, test files, and reports in a disclosed output directory.

dimensions.detail: Reading SwiftUI project code and PRD material, then producing XCTest and QA documentation, is proportionate for a test-generation skill.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The inspected artifact is a single Markdown skill file with no executable scripts, dependencies, remote payload retrieval, or install-time commands.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The skill says it automatically creates test files in qa-output/ and generates a report; this is workspace-writing behavior, but it is disclosed and scoped to QA outputs.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: No persistence, credential access, privilege escalation, background workers, memory writes, or system-level changes are described in the artifact.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The stated purpose is generating iOS SwiftUI test cases and QA documentation, and the instructions align with that purpose.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Installers should expect this skill to read project requirements/code and write generated QA artifacts under qa-output/. Review the generated XCTest files and reports before adding them to a production project, especially if qa-output/ already exists.
llm.findings: [SQP-2] expected: The scanner flagged automatic creation of test files. The artifact does state it creates files in qa-output/, which is purpose-aligned and scoped; users should still review generated files before merging or running them.
